We have some exciting news to share … we're thrilled to announce that we've just achieved SOC 2 Type I & II compliance certification, marking a new level in our commitment to providing our customers with top-notch security.

![](https://www.levitate.ai/blog/images/levitate-secures-soc-2-type-i-and-ii-certification-1.webp)

What does this mean? Well, we recently underwent a thorough audit by the pros at Prescient Assurance to ensure we’re meeting (and exceeding) data and security protocols. To us, it's not just about achieving a certification; it's about ensuring our customers’ data and our platform's security are as tight as they come.

For those wondering about the nitty-gritty details, here’s a quick explanation of SOC 2 Type I and Type II: Type I is like a snapshot of our cybersecurity controls at a specific point in time, ensuring everything is on point. Type II takes it a step further, evaluating our systems and controls over several months to make sure they're consistently effective in real-world scenarios.

Now, let's talk safeguards. Our SOC 2 certification affirms our commitment to top-tier security and privacy standards, such as things like: protection against unauthorized access, system availability strategies to minimize downtime, processing integrity to ensure accurate data processing, robust confidentiality safeguards, and a solid commitment to privacy practices.

As Robert Mills, our VP of Engineering, puts it, "Since Levitate’s inception, data security has been non-negotiable. Achieving SOC 2 certification underscores this dedication to providing a safe and secure platform for all our customers and also aligns us with AICPA & CIMA’s strict standards for our financial customers.”

As we keep growing, you can bet we're keeping a laser focus on user-friendly tech and top-notch data security so we can continue to be a trusted partner for relationship-based businesses.
